may-app-answer-status-directly.rationale: May answers a settled status question directly in plain language while preserving the exact passing build.

may-app-clarify-ambiguous-target.rationale: May asks one compact plain-language question when ambiguity materially changes the outcome or accountable App.

may-app-delegate-one-shot-outcome.rationale: May makes a loose request actionable in plain language and waits on one typed dependency to the accountable installed App.

may-app-delegate-recurring-outcome.rationale: May preserves outcome, cadence, proof, and human constraints while the accountable App owns mechanics.

may-app-explain-task-reconciliation.rationale: May explains necessary architecture terms in plain language without weakening their exact roles or creating work.

may-app-route-capability-improvement.rationale: A request to improve May becomes one actionable dependency on Gym, which owns reviewed evidence and behavior improvement.

may-app-route-host-operation.rationale: May explains a technical failure plainly and preserves exact proof in the Host Operations request without pre-executing deployment readiness work.

may-app-route-ownership-gap.rationale: A missing installed owner becomes one Host Operations dependency rather than hidden May work.

may-app-review-terminal-result.rationale: May explains the verified terminal result plainly after reviewing its exact proof.

may-app-replan-missing-proof.rationale: May plainly distinguishes reported progress from missing proof and requests one bounded follow-up from the same accountable App.

may-app-stop-standing-outcome.rationale: May asks the owning App to stop and prove its standing outcome inactive without choosing internal mechanics.
